complicacoes.texto: Years of “body-hopping” has left Jericho’s mind easily overruled by stronger, evil, e dangerous mental patterns that were never fully purged from his mind.
Jericho’s father is Deathstroke the Terminator, a man who tried singlehandedly to kill the Teen Titans.

Joseph Wilson was abducted as a small boy e his throat was slashed, rendering him mute. ALLIES Jericho worked longest e most closely com the Teen Titans, forging friendships com the core group. He worked mostly com Raven, who he felt was hurting in ways the rest of the team did not understand. Many of the Teen Titans of that time may still consider him a friend though he has repeatedly tried to kill them. His current ally is his father, Slade Wilson, Death - stroke the Terminator. ENEMIES The Teen Titans e the Justice League both consider Jericho a dangerous villain.
